visual_identity.core_identity: Small wiry goblinoid scavengers with ugly-cunning angular faces, oversized pointed ears, broad flattened noses, quick hands, and opportunistic body language.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small narrow torso, thin limbs, oversized pointed ears, slightly hunched or darting posture, large quick hands and feet, sparse hair only.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad flattened nose, angular cheeks, low brow, sharp chin, wide irregular-toothed mouth, large pointed ears, lively predatory eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean narrow-chested humanoid with sinewy limbs and a crouched scavenger stance rather than heroic or muscular proportions.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly bare leathery-looking skin with sparse hair; never a furry or fluffy outline.
must_avoid: bodybuilder chest, six-pack abs, or oversized heroic shoulders
visual_identity.limb_structure: Thin humanoid arms and legs with quick long-fingered hands and proportionally large feet; no claws, paws, tail, or animal limb structure.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw a small wiry goblin with narrow torso, thin forearms/calves, oversized pointed ears, no tail, and no heroic chest/ab definition; nearby human-scale masonry, door hardware, furniture, or props must prove the goblin is much smaller than an adult human.

accuracy_checks: goblin reads ugly-cunning rather than cute
ears and broad nose establish goblinoid identity
posture is quick, hunched, or opportunistic
torso stays narrow and wiry with no bodybuilder chest, six-pack abs, or oversized shoulders
no horns, tail, claws, or animal feet
hands and feet remain humanoid despite exaggerated goblin proportions

known_failure_modes.symptom: face reads like an imp or devil
known_failure_modes.correction: flatten the nose, remove demonic cues, strengthen angular goblinoid cheeks and oversized ears

known_failure_modes.symptom: face becomes cute, smooth, or childlike
known_failure_modes.correction: sharpen features with low brow, broad nose, irregular teeth, and scrappy expression

known_failure_modes.symptom: fur or fluff dominates the silhouette
known_failure_modes.correction: return to mostly bare leathery skin with sparse hair only

known_failure_modes.symptom: body becomes upright, broad-chested, bodybuilder-like, six-pack muscular, or heroically proportioned
known_failure_modes.correction: shrink the frame, narrow the chest and shoulders, remove bodybuilder muscle definition, and restore thin wiry limbs with a crouched scavenger posture

known_failure_modes.symptom: horns, tail, claws, or imp-like demonic anatomy appears
known_failure_modes.correction: remove horns, tail, claws, and animal feet; restore bare goblinoid head, humanoid hands/feet, broad nose, and oversized pointed ears

scene_identity.size_impression: Small, wiry, fast-looking goblinoid whose narrow body reads clearly smaller than a human or hobgoblin.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Slightly crouched, darting, peeking, scavenging, or hunched over a task rather than standing heroically upright.
behavior_style: scavenging or stealing one readable object
darting through rough lairs or storage areas
guarding or handling crude gear with opportunistic body language
environment_fit: rough dungeon rooms and storage spaces
caves and ruins used as lairs
crude camps, pantries, guard niches, and scavenged living spaces
